categories.main_business_segments: Samsara operates a single business segment focused on providing its Connected Operations Platform, which integrates IoT devices, cloud-based applications, and analytics to digitize and optimize physical operations. The platform includes core applications for Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Workforce Apps, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility, serving a broad range of industries reliant on physical assets and field operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a proprietary, cloud-native Data Platform that ingests, aggregates, and analyzes data from IoT devices and third-party systems. Key technologies include AI and machine learning for real-time analytics, edge computing for on-device processing, cellular and wireless connectivity, and an open API ecosystem. IoT devices are designed in-house but manufactured by joint design manufacturers in Asia using off-the-shelf components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Samsara serves organizations across industries such as transportation, logistics, construction, utilities, energy, government, manufacturing, field services, healthcare, education, and retail. Its customers range from small businesses to large enterprises and government entities, with a strategic focus on larger customers (over $100,000 in annual recurring revenue) that operate fleets, equipment, job sites, and distributed workforces.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with its primary market in the United States (87% of revenue), and international operations in Western Europe, Canada, Mexico, and other regions. Samsara has offices and employees in the US, Canada, Mexico, Taiwan, India, England, France, Germany, Poland, and the Benelux region, and continues to expand its international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Samsara operates downstream in the supply chain, providing end-to-end solutions directly to customers. It designs IoT devices and software but outsources manufacturing to joint design manufacturers, primarily in Asia, and integrates with OEMs and third-party systems to capture and analyze operational data.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategy centers on continuous customer-centric innovation, expanding its platform’s applications and data types, and leveraging AI to deliver actionable insights. R&D priorities include enhancing AI/ML capabilities, developing new applications for broader operational use cases, expanding third-party integrations, and supporting global and multi-asset operations. Samsara invests heavily in R&D to maintain technology leadership and address evolving customer needs.
categories.revenue_model: Samsara generates approximately 98% of its revenue from multi-year (typically 3-5 years), non-cancelable subscriptions to its Connected Operations Platform, priced on a per asset, per application basis. The subscription includes access to cloud applications, IoT data collection, cellular connectivity, support, and warranty. Additional revenue comes from replacement hardware sales and professional services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from a fragmented set of vendors offering point solutions for fleet management, telematics, safety, and asset tracking, such as Lytx, Geotab, Motive, Verizon Connect, Omnitracs, Netradyne, and others. Samsara differentiates itself by offering a unified, cloud-native platform that spans multiple asset types and operational domains, positioning itself as a category leader in connected operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended February 1, 2025, Samsara reported $1.25 billion in revenue, up 33% year-over-year, with over 20,000 core customers and 2,506 large customers (>$100,000 ARR). The company continues to operate at a net loss ($154.9 million in FY25), but has demonstrated rapid growth, strong gross margins (76%), and improving operating leverage as it scales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Samsara’s value proposition lies in providing a single, integrated platform that delivers real-time visibility, analytics, and automation across fleets, equipment, sites, and frontline workers. Its differentiators include AI-powered insights from a massive and diverse IoT data set, ease of deployment and use, extensibility through APIs and integrations, measurable ROI in safety, efficiency, and sustainability, and a strong customer-centric culture.
